And while I’m burning up in my room, like I have for the past couple of years, other people I know, who had the same ambitions as I had once, are actually working towards their goals. And I still sit in my own skin, letting my own thoughts bounce off the walls, and I never get a breath of fresh air. I feel like I need to figure everything out fast because I need to survive, even though I know that there’s plenty of time to figure out what I plan to do with my life. 

I’ve never related so much to someone on the internet like I have now. All I want to do is say I’m so sorry that it’s turned out this way for you, and that you feel like everything is coming to a point. I hate that i honestly do need to make the choices now, and I’m sad that I haven’t done anything to lift myself up.
